newsitem.title: BELGIUM: SOCCER-SCIFO, DOLL OUT FOR BELGIUM V SAN MARINO.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-SCIFO, DOLL OUT FOR BELGIUM V SAN MARINO.

text.p: Monaco's Enzo Scifo and Anderlecht defender Olivier Doll are injured and unavailable for Belgium's World Cup qualifier against San Marino on Saturday, a soccer union spokesman said on Monday.
Belgium coach Georges Leekens instead drafted Lierse midfielder Filip Haagdoren and Club Brugge defender Dirk Medved into his squad.
He also added Mouscron striker Mbo Mpenza to be covered for a possible pull-out by Fiorentina's Luis Oliveira who is hampered by an ankle injury.
Scifo, who is moving to Anderlecht, has been dogged by a toe injury and Doll has a thigh problem.
